_meta.what_this_is: A small English training text for a byte-pair-encoding tokenizer, plus sample strings and a token budget. The BPE learns merges from the common words in train_text, so those words compress to few tokens; the samples deliberately mix that common prose with digit strings and rare letter sequences the tokenizer has no merges for, so the characters-per-token ratio swings and a character-based truncation overflows the token budget.
_meta.results_are: A FIXTURE. train_text is ordinary English so the merges are the familiar ones (th, er, the, and); samples are authored so at least two overflow an 8-token budget when truncated by the 4-chars-per-token heuristic. Point it at your own text.
_meta.budget: the token budget a truncation must fit
